name: Saba

flag.description: A white diamond touching the middle of each edge, with a yellow five-pointed star at its centre; the two top corners are red and the two bottom corners blue.
flag.symbolism: Red, white and blue show Saba's ties to the Netherlands; red also stands for courage, unity and strength, white for peace, blue for the sea, and the yellow star for the island itself.

hook: Saba is the Dutch red, white and blue folded into a diamond, with a single gold star in the middle and nothing else.
trivia: The design was chosen in 1985 from about 130 entries and was the work of 18-year-old islander Edmond Johnson.
Saba's Mount Scenery, at 870 m, is the highest point in the whole Kingdom of the Netherlands.
